descriptions.description: Bonnemaisonia is a genus of red algae belonging to the family Bonnemaisoniaceae. The genus name of Bonnemaisonia is in honour of Théophile Bonnemaison (1774–1829), a French pharmacist, botanist and naturalist from Quimper. The genus has almost cosmopolitan distribution. Species: Bonnemaisonia asparagoides Bonnemaisonia clavata Bonnemaisonia geniculata Bonnemaisonia hamifera Bonnemaisonia nootkana
